SUshi menu

LION SUSHI

SUSHI

apanese rolls that are rolled with seaweed and japanese sushi rice
and filled with a variety of ingredients are almost too good to eat

Dragon Roll (8pcs)

Prawn Tempura, eel, avocado & Mayonnaise, sprinkled with crispy tempura crunches and finished with a drizzle of Unagi sauce.

£14.95

Rainbow roll (8pcs)

Crab stick, avocado, Mayonnaise and thinly sliced salmon, seabass & tuna.

£15.95

Crazy Salmon Roll

Salmon avocado filling inside topped with spicy salmon crunch

£16.95

Spider roll (6pcs)

Tempura fried soft shell crab, cucumber and spring onion & flying fish roe.

TEMAKI

£13.95

Known as hand rolls; cone shaped nori filled with japanese sushi rice
and a selection of fillings, each bite making you go in for more.

California Temaki

Crab Stick,Japanese Mayonnaise ,avocado ,cucumber flying fish roe & finished with a sprinkle of sesame seeds

£7.95

Spicy Tuna Temaki

Diced Tuna,Japanese mayo,spring onion & Mixed chilli spices.

£8.95

Salmon and avocado temaki

£7.95

PLATTERS

(CHEF’S SPECIAL SELECTION) – Perfect for Sharing

MEDIUM PLATTER

SUSHI (6pcs)
MAKI (8pcs)
SASHIMI (6pcs)

£39.95

LARGE PLATTER

SASHIMI(15pcs)
SUSHI(8 pcs)
MAKI(24pcs)

£64.95

MAGURO SAKE (10pcs)

Tuna and salmon sashimi.

£14.95

EBI - PRAWN Sushi (2pcs)

£4.95

IKA - SQUID Sushi (2pcs)

£4.95

SABA - MACKEREL Sushi (2pcs)

£5.95

SABA - MACKEREL Sashimi(5pcs)

£7.95

SAKE - SALMON Sushi (2pcs)

£5.95

SAKE - SALMON Sashimi (5pcs)

£8.95

MAGURO- TUNA Sushi (2pcs)

£6.95

MAGURO- TUNA Sashimi (5pcs)

£9.95

UNAGI- EEL Sushi (2pcs)

£6.95

UNAGI- EEL Sashimi (5pcs)

£8.95

MAKI

Maki,also known as makimono are sushi rolls rolled with seaweed
coming from the japanese word Imono.” ura maki”
meaning inverted sushi rolls, they ’ll make your taste buds go crazy.

Makimono HOSO Maki (Nori outside) 6pcs
Kappa Maki(v) cucumber roll

£6.95

Avocado Maki (v)

£7.95

California Maki (8pcs)

Japanese Mayo, Avocado, Crab Stick, Cucumber & flying fish roe, finished with a sprinkle of sesame seeds.

£9.95

Tori Age Maki (8pcs)

Chicken tempura filling, finished with a dizzle of UNAGI Sauce.

£10.95

Salmon Avocado Maki (8pcs)

Salmon, Avocado, Japanese Mayo & flying fish roe.

£10.95

Ebi California Maki (8pcs)

Tiger prawn, Cucumber, Avocado, Japanese mayo & flying fish roe finished with sesame seeds

£10.95

Spicy Tuna Maki (8pcs)

Diced Tuna, Japanese mayo, Spring onion & mixed chili spices finished with sesame seeds.

£12.95

Ebi Tempura Maki (8pcs)

Deep fried tempura prawns, Cucumber, Japanese Mayo and finished with sesame seeds

£10.95

Dynamite Maki (8pcs)

Deep fried maki with Prawn, eel, avocado, mayo & Unagi sauce.

£12.95

Spicy Beef maki (8pcs )

Spicy succulent beef, Japanese spiced mayo

£11.95

Crazy Salmon Roll

Salmon avocado filling inside topped with spicy salmon crunch

£12.50
